quarter_net_revenue.column: First quarter column; 16 weeks ended 2026-08-30; Total revenue; source in millions

prior_quarter_net_revenue.column: Second quarter column; corresponding quarter ended 2025-08-31; Total revenue; source in millions

quarter_gaap_diluted_eps.column: First quarter column; GAAP diluted EPS; 16 weeks ended 2026-08-30; listed common stock; no separate class dimension

annual_release_gaap_diluted_eps.column: Third numeric column; full fiscal year ended 2026-08-30; GAAP diluted EPS; listed common stock; no separate class dimension

calculated_quarter_revenue_growth.note: Same consolidated revenue definition and corresponding fiscal-quarter columns; not headline net-sales growth.

extraction_note: Explicit fiscal-quarter headers, unit scale, total/net revenue label and diluted EPS row determine the observations.
